audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart gave Yone all seven rows; content win[] and the packet levelChart both read Orianna, Skill x5, Orianna.
audit.why: He is melee with a 450-range Mortal Steel at level 1 and she out-ranges him at 815; grouped, one Shockwave answers a single-target Fate Sealed dive. The middle rows are genuinely even at a 48.53% win rate over 2510 games.
audit.corrected: All seven full sides moved onto the content/packet verdict with whys and ratings rewritten. win[] already held the correct tokens.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase whys were generic Orianna boilerplate, and the content whys were offset by a row — whys[1] described the level-6 ult interaction under the Level 2 row, whys[2] described first item under Level 3, and so on.
audit.why: Every row rendered a sentence about a different stage of the game than its own label.
audit.corrected: whys[1] through whys[5] rewritten to describe their own rows, keyed to Mortal Steel's two-stack knockup, Spirit Cleave's 14s shield, Soul Unbound at 22s->10s, Fate Sealed at 1000 range, and the shared first-item window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that his abilities are never named, and wants.you[3] said to Shockwave 'his R re-emergence point' — Fate Sealed does not re-emerge.
audit.why: Soul Unbound (E) is the ability that leaves his body behind and snaps his spirit back to it; Fate Sealed (R) is a 1000-range blink behind the last champion in a line that pulls everyone hit toward him. Spirit Cleave (W) shields him more the more champions it hits, on a 14s cooldown, which is why extended trades favour him.
audit.corrected: Real names now used throughout the full layer; wants.you[3] retargeted to the Soul Unbound snap-back, which is the position you can actually predict.

audit.why: It is the field that holds real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Soul Unbound 22/19/16/13/10, Spirit Cleave 14s, Fate Sealed 120s and your R at 110s stated.

audit.corrected: Both rewritten against his dash and blink ranges.

notes: Two structural defects here beyond the lint list. First, all seven full-layer chart rows disagreed with the content layer and the packet; the full layer was moved onto their verdict (win[] already correct, so no content chart edit). Second, the content whys array was offset by a row — whys[1] described level 6 under the Level 2 label, whys[2] described first item under Level 3, and so on down the chart; whys[1] to whys[5] are rewritten to describe their own rows. wants.you[3] told the reader to Shockwave his 'R re-emergence point', but it is Soul Unbound (E) that snaps him back to his body, not Fate Sealed; retargeted. The packet's note that no Yone ability is ever named is addressed on the full layer.
